Scientific Administrative Assistant: Graduate degree in science discipline with minimum 60% marks. Desirable: Practical Knowledge in Bioinformatics.

content_sections.heading: CUSB Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the CUSB Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download CUSB Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CUSB Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Research Associate I, 1 for Project Associate 1 and 1 for Scientific Administrative Assistant.

content_sections.heading: CUSB Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Associate I: Ph.D. in Bioinformatics/ Computational Biology and a good academic record. Desirable: At least two research papers in a peer-reviewed journal. Project Associate 1: M.Sc./ M.Tech in Bioinformatics with minimum 60% marks. Desirable: Experience in computational analysis of Biological data and commitment towards research. Scientific Administrative Assistant: Graduate degree in science discipline with minimum 60% marks. Desirable: Practical Knowledge in Bioinformatics.

content_sections.heading: CUSB Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Research Associate I: 58000+9% HRA Project Associate 1: 31000+9% HRA Scientific Administrative Assistant: 18000+9% HRA

content_sections.heading: CUSB Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on merit and project requirement Offline interview via email

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the CUSB Recruitment 2026 is 10 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this CUSB recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Research Associate-I, Project Associate-1, and Scientific Administrative Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for CUSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Scientific Administrative Assistant post, a Graduate degree in a science discipline with a minimum of 60% marks is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Research Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Associate-I position is 58000 plus 9% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit mentioned for these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any age-related information.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CUSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an offline interview conducted via email.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions at CUSB?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is temporary.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is CUSB/Dev/RP-134/272.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Central University of South Bihar located?
faq.answer: The Central University of South Bihar is located in Gaya, Bihar, with the pincode 824236.
